Class Server

java.lang.Object
marius.server.data.Server
@Entity public class Server extends Object
Represents a Python agent stored in the server table. Notes:
  • The ip field must be in IPv4 format and must be unique.
  • The state field is true when the client is reachable, false otherwise.
  • The port field stores the agent's port number (0–65,535). It is marked as @Transient and @JsonIgnore, so it is excluded from JSON serialization and is not persisted to the database.
